en.title: Beethoven: String Quartet Op. 18 No. 5 – III. Andante cantabile (theme and variations)
en.overview: This movement is a theme and variations in D major. A simple, singing tune is heard first, then changed five times. After that comes a slow coda. Listen for where the tune hides: sometimes high, sometimes low, sometimes buried in busy notes. The harmony labels here come from an expert analysis. The "who leads" labels are a rough guess, so I mark the uncertain ones.

listening_points.headline: The theme: a calm tune in Violin 1
listening_points.text: Violin 1 starts the tune alone and softly [m. 0]. The others join from [m. 1]. The tune opens with a leap upward, then steps gently down. Soon the other parts move with lines of their own under the tune [m. 2-6]. The theme and each of the five variations are repeated; the coda is heard once.

listening_points.headline: A brief brightening, then home again
listening_points.text: The music touches A major for a moment [m. 7-8]. Then it returns to D major. Around [m. 9-10] the cello probably shares the spotlight, though this is uncertain. A crescendo (gradual getting louder) starts at [m. 11].

listening_points.headline: Variation 1: the cello takes the tune
listening_points.text: Now the cello plays the tune alone and then with accompaniment [m. 16-20]. It is still soft. There are more notes than before: about one and a half times as many as in the theme.

listening_points.headline: Var. 1: sudden accents and passing of the tune
listening_points.text: A crescendo leads to a sudden sharp accent (sf) at [m. 23]. The key brightens to A major here. Later the lead seems to pass between the middle parts [m. 26-31], probably the viola and second violin, but this is uncertain. Another crescendo and accent come at [m. 30-31].

listening_points.headline: Variation 2: Violin 1 spins a whisper
listening_points.text: The music drops to very soft (pp). Violin 1 clearly leads with flowing, faster notes. The tune is decorated rather than plainly stated. Listen for little swells and fades in [m. 42-44].

listening_points.headline: Variation 3: the most notes, the tune spread between parts
listening_points.text: This variation has the most notes so far. The viola starts alone [m. 48]. After that, the tune moves between Violin 2, Viola and Violin 1. The leader is unclear, so listen for a shared texture. Accents and crescendos build toward the end [m. 62-64b].

listening_points.headline: Variation 4: the tune returns, but the harmony wanders
listening_points.text: Violin 1 clearly has the tune again, played more plainly. But the chords underneath change. The music turns to a darker F# minor [m. 70-72]. This is a shadowy moment.

listening_points.headline: Back to D major and a hushed ending
listening_points.text: The key returns to D major [m. 73]. A crescendo at [m. 77] is followed by a pp (very soft) at [m. 79]. The calm sets up a big contrast.

listening_points.headline: Variation 5: a sudden loud burst
listening_points.text: The music jumps to forte (loud), starting with the instruments playing one line together in octaves [m. 80]. The tune is mostly in the inner parts, Viola and Violin 2. The leader is very uncertain. The analysis marks [m. 84] as the loudest point.

listening_points.headline: Loud music keeps going, parts trade the lead
listening_points.text: The key is back in D major. The loud energy continues with accents at [m. 93]. The lead moves between several parts and is hard to pin down. Hear it as a shared conversation.

listening_points.headline: A sudden hush in a new key
listening_points.text: Suddenly it drops to soft and the key shifts to B-flat major [m. 96b-104]. The cello is alone at [m. 97]. Then the music gets quieter, and a crescendo builds. It returns to D major at [m. 105].

listening_points.headline: The opening tune returns low in the cello
listening_points.text: Back in D major, the cello plays the opening tune two octaves lower [m. 107-110]. It is very soft. Violin 1 then takes the lead [m. 111-115]. Violin 2 probably follows [m. 116-118].

listening_points.headline: Building up to a loud arrival
listening_points.text: The lines are busy and independent [m. 120-124]. Crescendos and accents build the tension [m. 124-127]. It reaches loud at [m. 128].

listening_points.headline: Coda: slower, softer, fading away
listening_points.text: The coda is marked Poco Adagio, a bit slower. It starts loud, with all parts moving together in chords [m. 129]. Then it drops to pp, with fragments passing between parts [m. 130-134]. Violin 1 probably leads the soft ending in D major [m. 135-139].

glossary.explanation: A new version of the same tune, with changed notes, texture or mood.
A sudden, sharp accent on a note or chord.
All parts move together in the same rhythm, like chords.
Two or more instruments play the same notes, at the same height or at different heights.
A closing section that rounds off the movement.
The home note and scale a passage centres on. Major keys sound bright, minor keys darker.

zh.title: 贝多芬弦乐四重奏 Op. 18 No. 5 – 第三乐章 如歌的行板(主题与变奏)
zh.overview: 这是一个主题与变奏乐章:先出现一支简单的旋律,然后用五种不同的方式改造它,最后以一段缓慢的尾声收束。本乐章以D大调为主,2/4拍。请留意旋律在四件乐器之间如何转手,以及每段变奏音符的疏密变化:第三变奏最密,第四变奏又回到和主题差不多。第五变奏最长、最响,尾声则安静地结束。本指南的和声标注来自专家标注,可信度较高。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴唱出主题
listening_points.text: 乐章一开始,第一小提琴先独自轻声奏出主题的开头 [m. 0],从第 1 小节起其他乐器加入。旋律先向上一跳,然后一步步往下走,简单又好记。从第 2 小节起,其他声部也有各自的线条 [m. 2-6],力度弱(p)。请记住这支旋律,它会再次出现。

listening_points.headline: 短暂转到A大调,再回到D大调
listening_points.text: [m. 7-8] 音乐短暂走到A大调,色彩稍有变化。随后在 [m. 9] 回到D大调。中间有一小段渐强 [m. 11],之后又回到轻声 [m. 13]。主题在 [m. 16] 结束。

listening_points.headline: 第一变奏:大提琴接过旋律
listening_points.text: 第一变奏里,大提琴最常带着旋律,声音低沉温暖 [m. 16-20]。音符比主题更密,大约是1.5倍。之后旋律在中提琴和第二小提琴之间转手,这部分的领奏判断不太确定。[m. 23] 和 [m. 31] 有突然加重的重音(sf)。

listening_points.headline: 第二变奏:很弱的小提琴流动线条
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴重新领奏,声音降到很弱(pp)[m. 32-47]。旋律被装饰得更流畅,音符比主题密。请听这段安静而细腻的歌唱。[m. 39-40] 再次短暂转到A大调,[m. 41] 回到D大调。

listening_points.headline: 第三变奏:音符最密,旋律在声部间轮流出现
listening_points.text: 这一段音符最密,约是主题的2.5倍。中提琴先开始 [m. 48],然后第二小提琴和第一小提琴轮流出现。旋律在各声部间流转,领奏很分散。快到结尾 [m. 62-63] 有渐强和突强的重音。

listening_points.headline: 第四变奏:旋律回到小提琴,转入小调
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴又清楚地领奏,音符数量与主题差不多 [m. 64-72]。到 [m. 69-72] 音乐转入升F小调,气氛变暗。这是全乐章唯一的小调段落。

listening_points.headline: 回到D大调,渐强之后转为很弱
listening_points.text: [m. 73] 回到明亮的D大调。[m. 77] 有渐强,随后到 [m. 79] 变成很弱(pp)。这为下一段突然的爆发做好了铺垫。

listening_points.headline: 第五变奏突然变响
listening_points.text: 第五变奏一开始就是强(f),几件乐器同度或八度齐奏 [m. 80]。旋律主要在中提琴和第二小提琴一带,领奏不明确,可以当作共同分担。按分析,[m. 84] 是全乐章最响的地方。[m. 86-88a] 短暂转到A大调。

listening_points.headline: 突然转入降B大调,声音骤然安静
listening_points.text: [m. 96b] 音乐突然变轻(p),并转入降B大调。听起来像是忽然换了一个远方的色彩。[m. 97] 只有大提琴独奏,之后降到更弱(pp)[m. 98]。[m. 105] 又回到D大调。

listening_points.headline: 主题在低音大提琴中回归
listening_points.text: [m. 107-110] 大提琴低两个八度重新奏出开头的主题旋律,音的走向与最初一致。声音很弱(pp)。这是辨认“老朋友”的好时机。

listening_points.headline: 逐步积累,在第 128 小节变强
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴可能接着唱 [m. 111-115],然后由第二小提琴接过旋律 [m. 116-118]。之后几个声部的线条交错,反复渐强 [m. 119, 124]。到 [m. 126] 有突强的重音,[m. 128] 变强(f)。

listening_points.headline: 尾声:速度放慢,变得很弱
listening_points.text: 尾声标为 Poco Adagio,意思是稍慢一点。[m. 129] 先是强,然后迅速减弱,到 [m. 130] 变为很弱(pp)。[m. 129] 各声部以和弦一起进行,随后第一小提琴独奏 [m. 130-131],再变成二重、三重的薄织体 [m. 132-134]。

listening_points.headline: 轻柔的和弦收束本乐章
listening_points.text: 最后几小节有短暂的渐强和渐弱 [m. 135-137],像一次轻轻的呼吸。第一小提琴可能领着旋律。[m. 138-139] 以整齐的和弦在D大调里安静地结束。

glossary.explanation: 把同一支旋律用不同的装饰、音型、声部或情绪再演奏一遍。
本乐章最先出现、之后被反复改造的那支旋律。
音乐的“中心音”和色彩。大调通常明亮,小调通常较暗。
音乐暂时走到另一个调,听起来像换了一种色彩。
突然加重的一个音或和弦。
意大利语,意思是“稍微慢一些”。
几件乐器同时奏出相同的音,或相差八度的同一个音。
